## About
Dr. Ron Blaha started in nursing, then studied massage therapy and chiropractic side by side after moving to Dallas. He earned his LMT license from the Massage Institute of Healing Arts and finished his chiropractic training at Parker College of Chiropractic. Since then he has added certifications in acupuncture and clinical nutrition, a Doctor of Naturopathy, and he practices family medicine as a Family Nurse Practitioner.
That mix is the point. Our approach integrates Chiromassage, Chiropractic Care, and Family Medicine, so your adjustments, your massage and your checkups can all happen with people who already know you.
One longtime patient says Dr. Ron has seen her through big life events and now takes care of her kids too. In Dr. Blaha's words, he looks forward to helping you on your "Journey to Self-Healing."

## Services
- Chiropractic Care: Adjustments and alignments aimed at easing pain and keeping you moving. One patient with arthritis in her neck says regular alignments ended her pain and headaches.
- Chiromassage: Massage from skilled therapists to release tension and help you relax, in a quiet, calm setting.
- Annual Physical: A thorough yearly checkup to keep an eye on your overall health and catch concerns early.
- Routine Bloodwork: Blood tests that check key health markers and guide your care going forward.
- Diabetes: Ongoing support, education and a management plan built around your needs.
- High-Blood Pressure: Regular monitoring and lifestyle changes to help you manage and lower your blood pressure.
- Skin Aesthetics: Botox, facial fillers, micro-needling, dermabrasion, facials and hydro facials.
- Weight Loss Programs: Personal plans that look at your metabolism, lifestyle and goals, combining nutrition, exercise and lifestyle changes.

## FAQ
Q: Can Dr. Blaha be my regular family doctor?
A: Yes. Along with chiropractic care, Dr. Blaha practices family medicine as a Family Nurse Practitioner, covering things like physicals, bloodwork, diabetes, high blood pressure and asthma.

Q: Do you treat animals?
A: Dr. Blaha is a Certified Animal Chiropractor. Give us a call to talk about your horse or dog.

Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Use the Book An Appointment button on this page, or give us a call and we'll find a time that works for you.
